craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Glimpse-bent kept; made-making (sādhyasṛṣṭi) kept per UNC; deemed-deemed double. Rejected: (a) modernizing → killed: raw kept raw. Read aloud: MĀ-yā — FORM in-DEED … WITH-drawn GOD-dess-DEEMED.

lines: Māyā — form indeed — bent to glimpse a little, know made-making;
other power — keeping deemed; from loosing, withdrawn goddess deemed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyā rūpaṃ hi yat kiṃcid ālokayitum udyatā | anyā śaktiḥ sthitir matā

reads_against.argmap: What does māyā will? → Māyā willing perception; other powers considered.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
